literal_meaning: কান উঁচু করে বা খাড়া করে রাখা
figurative_meaning_bn: শোনার জন্য কান খাড়া করে আছে এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Eagerly listening with ears perked up
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চারা উৎকর্ণ হয়ে গল্পের অপেক্ষায় ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: She was all ears listening to the news.
The children were eagerly waiting with bated breath for the story.
note: This idiom draws from natural imagery of animals perking up their ears, common in Indo-Aryan languages.
